title: Account Concierge: enterprise ask aggregation & starter-scope playbook
creator: Leah Ortiz
description: Playbook to consolidate Sales/CS enterprise feature requests into a single 'concierge' ticket per account cluster, produce an initial technical & econ sketch, and route for PM/Eng review. Designed to reduce duplication, speed first-pass scoping, and capture decision signals (SLA/security/compliance) early. This document defines roles, data sources, scoring heuristics, required artifacts, and escalation paths.
background: Sales and CS currently create many overlapping asks for high-touch accounts. PMs spend repeated cycles re-collecting the same info (use-case, scale, data classification, success metrics). We need a repeatable process that: (1) groups related asks across contacts/products, (2) produces a one-page starter-scope with cost levers and risks, (3) surfaces blockers (KMS, VPC, audit) and (4) funnels decisions into PM backlog or Solution Engineering handoff.
scoring_heuristic: 1) Account value weight (MRR/ARR) 40% 2) Expected usage volume (tokens/month) 25% 3) Security/regulatory friction 20% (higher reduces score) 4) Strategic fit & speed to value 15%
required_artifacts: - Sales intake form copy or transcript - Customer business-impact blurb (1-2 sentences) - Estimated monthly request volume or example traces - Minimal compliance flags (PII, finance, healthcare) - Desired SLOs/latency and availability - Any referenced PR/Confluence links
acceptance_criteria: Concierge ticket exists per account cluster with consolidated asks (no more than 3 related sub-asks)
Starter-scope one-pager attached and reviewed by assigned PM
Initial econ sketch with token/host cost estimate and suggested levers (batching, quantization, dedicated capacity)
Security/regulatory blockers identified and owner assigned
Decision outcome chosen: Backlog | SolutionEng Handoff | Decline
